column1: # defective function<TAB>src file whose code reaches the defect (constitution 1.8.1)
# getCobraSolverParams: the defect is confined to the two-input call form (no paramStructure),
# which ignores the global parameters; these files make such a call outside comments.
# Node: the defects are confined to the methods removeDuplicateLiterals (wrong children removed
# when literal children are not the first children) and isequal. isequal is called on nodes
# nowhere in src/; the only call of removeDuplicateLiterals (combineChildren.m:64) is on a CNF
# clause flattened by reduce(), whose children are all literals, so no caller reaches the defects.
# getRankLUSOL: only the third output q is wrong (zero columns); callers that take q reach it.
# nullSpaceOperator: only scale = 0 fails; both callers (fourFundamentalSubpaces, getNullSpace) pass 1.
# lsqr: fails only with 4 or more outputs (r1norm unassigned); lsqrtest requests 7 outputs.
# configCMatrix: reached through loadModular('CMatrix') (str2func of the module name); configPolytopeSimplifier makes that call.
# CMatrix, ddouble, qdouble: only the sparse triplet constructor CMatrix(i,j,s,...) is defective; no src caller uses it.
# prepareTest: only the needsLinux option fails; no src file passes it.
# py_rmpath: only MATLAB_too = true fails; the only caller (initPythonEnvironment) passes 0.

# writeLPProblem: the unusable outputFormat/writeMatrix-first forms are used by no caller; vartype is dropped only for problems with vartype and no solverParams, and the callers without solverParams write LP/QP problems.
# setCplexParametersForProblem: only the MIQP path is defective; solveCobraMIQP is the only caller that takes it.
# checkGAMSSolvers: only problem types GAMS does not list fail; all callers pass 'MIP'.
# BDCA: x_error/Time are wrong on every call, so BDCA is its own seed (default: every caller reaches it).
# setGurobiParam: the timelimit override depends on the user's parameters (both names set); solveCobraLP and solveCobraQP pass the user's parameters.
# getDietComposition: only the documented model (struct) input fails; all callers pass cell arrays.
# calcMDVfromSamp: only a non-empty glc reaches convert_input; runHiLoExp passes one.
# getElementalWeightMatrix: only the documented printWarning input fails; callers pass 0 or 1 argument.
# changeCobraSolverParams: only omitting the documented-optional solverType fails; callers pass all three arguments.
# addAnnotations: only the documented option annotationVerification is ignored; no caller passes it.
# addInfoFromMolFiles: only the second output IDAdded is unassigned; every caller requests one output.
# optimalScores: only an rxnList with exactly one matched reaction fails; only reactionCompareGUI (EXCLUDED, GUI) passes rxnList.
# elementalMatrixToFormulae: only dMax = 0 drops counts of 1; every caller (computeMetFormulae) passes 10 and the default is 12.
# changeNodesArea: only the documented three-input call fails; no src file calls it.
# initPythonEnvironment: only the default/'CPython3' environment reaches the version check; both callers (writeModelinJSON, autoFragment) pass a conda environment name.
